name: oci-error-corpus
note: Branch on code+http_status first; regex is a fallback for null/absent codes. Web-sourced rows are untrusted data.

envelope_regexes.config_missing: ^ERROR: Could not find config file at (?P<path>.+)$
envelope_regexes.profile_missing: ^ERROR: Profile '(?P<profile>[^']+)' not found in config file (?P<path>\S+)
envelope_regexes.no_security_token: ^ERROR: No security_token_file was found in config for profile: (?P<profile>\S+)$
envelope_regexes.session_expired: This CLI session has expired, so it cannot currently be used to run commands
envelope_regexes.key_file_missing: FileNotFoundError: \[Errno 2\] No such file or directory: '(?P<path>.+\.pem)'

entries.cause: Body is not valid JSON, or a service-specific query grammar was violated
entries.fix: Validate JSON; for Search, quote the query as `query all resources where ...`. Reproduced live: `oci search resource structured-search --query-text "bogus"` -> `Syntax error near: extraneous input 'bogus' expecting QUERY`

entries.cause: A body/query parameter value is invalid or malformed
entries.fix: Check the operation in the REST API ref; fix the value. Do not retry

entries.cause: A **path** component is syntactically valid but disallowed
entries.fix: Distinguish by `status`: 400 = body/query, 404 = URI path

entries.cause: Required field absent from the body
entries.fix: Add the field per the API ref

entries.cause: Tenancy-wide Oracle service limit hit
entries.fix: `oci limits value list --service-name <svc> --compartment-id <tenancy>` then request an increase

entries.cause: Admin-defined **compartment quota** blocks it (not an Oracle limit)
entries.fix: `oci limits quota list --compartment-id <tenancy>`; edit/remove the quota policy statement

entries.cause: An OCID **inside the request body** (subnet, image, vault key, NSG) is missing or unreadable by you
entries.fix: Verify each body OCID exists in the right region/compartment and policy grants read on it

entries.cause: Bad `storageTier` value
entries.fix: Use a valid tier for that operation

entries.regex: `The required information to complete authentication was not provided or was incorrect\.`
entries.cause: Signature/key/clock/region-subscription problem — see §6
entries.fix: Never a policy problem. Fix credentials, not policies

entries.regex: `.*must be directed at the home region.*`
entries.cause: IAM write op sent to a non-home region
entries.fix: Re-issue with `--region <home region>`; find it via `oci iam region-subscription list --query "data[?\"is-home-region\"]"`

entries.regex: `.*not authorized to update one or more of the fields.*`
entries.cause: You may call the op but not touch a specific field (e.g. `definedTags`, `compartmentId`)
entries.fix: Remove the offending field from the request, or get the field-level policy

entries.cause: Service not enabled for the tenancy (common on Gen-AI, some ADB features)
entries.fix: Subscribe/opt in via Console, or open a Support request

entries.regex: `Authorization failed or requested resource not found\.`
entries.cause: Deliberate ambiguity: missing resource OR missing policy OR wrong region OR wrong compartment
entries.fix: See §3 — the single most common OCI error

entries.regex: `.*no operation supported at the URI path.*`
entries.cause: Wrong static path / wrong API version / typo'd service endpoint
entries.fix: Not a permissions issue. Check the endpoint and API version

entries.cause: Object Storage namespace wrong or unreadable
entries.fix: `oci os ns get` to obtain the real namespace for the tenancy

entries.cause: PUT vs POST vs PATCH mismatch
entries.fix: Check the API ref verb

entries.cause: **Non-transient** state conflict
entries.fix: Do NOT poll. Change the request or the resource

entries.cause: Resource is mid-transition (`PROVISIONING`, `TERMINATING`, `UPDATING`)
entries.fix: Wait for the target state. In CLI use `--wait-for-state`; in SDK use `oci.wait_until`

entries.cause: A customer-owned server (DB agent, on-prem host, Exadata) is unreachable/misbehaving
entries.fix: Check the external host and its logs; retry with backoff

entries.cause: `opc-retry-token` was reused after the entity it created was deleted/changed
entries.fix: Generate a **new** idempotency token. Never reuse a token across logically distinct creates

entries.cause: A resource lock (full/delete) or a parent-tenancy quota lock
entries.fix: `oci <svc> <res> get` to read `locks[]`; remove the lock, or pass `--is-lock-override true` where supported

entries.cause: Create-only variant of NAONF: name collision OR no create permission
entries.fix: List for an existing same-named resource first; then check the `manage` policy verb

entries.cause: Optimistic-concurrency `if-match` stale
entries.fix: Re-`get` the resource, take the fresh `etag`, resend

entries.cause: Body over the service cap
entries.fix: Split the request; for Object Storage use multipart upload

entries.cause: JSON parses but the combination is nonsense (e.g. incompatible shape+image)
entries.fix: Fix the semantic combination

entries.cause: Per-user/per-tenancy throttle
entries.fix: Exponential backoff + jitter. See §5.3

entries.cause: Oversized headers, usually huge `opc-meta-*` on Object Storage
entries.fix: Shrink metadata headers

entries.cause: Service-side fault or transient outage
entries.fix: Retry with backoff; if persistent, file support with `opc-request-id`

entries.cause: Op not implemented at that endpoint
entries.fix: Check API ref

entries.cause: Outage / maintenance
entries.fix: Backoff; check

entries.cause: Dependency host unreachable
entries.fix: Backoff; verify the external system

entries.cause: Dependency host slow
entries.fix: Backoff

entries.cause: Dependency host returned garbage
entries.fix: Backoff; inspect the external system

entries.cause: No physical hypervisor capacity for that shape in that AD/FD. Endemic to Always-Free `VM.Standard.A1.Flex`
entries.fix: Change shape / change FD / change AD / **omit** fault domain so OCI picks. Doc:
entries.retry_note: 500 but NOT retryable in place - vary AD/FD/shape

entries.cause: You want to know *before* launching
entries.fix: `oci compute compute-capacity-report create -c <root compartment> --availability-domain <AD> --shape-availabilities file://shapes.json` — note `--compartment-id` **must be the root compartment** . The CLI subcommand is `compute-capacity-report`, **not** `capacity-report` (that name errors with `No such command`)

entries.cause: Tenancy shape/OCPU limit, distinct from physical capacity
entries.fix: `oci limits value list --compartment-id <tenancy> --service-name compute` then request an increase. Free-tier A1 cap is 4 OCPU / 24 GB total

entries.cause: Always-Free entitlement consumed
entries.fix: Terminate an existing Always-Free resource or upgrade to PAYG

entries.cause: Service returns a **specific** message rather than the generic one — seen in Oracle's own OKE docs
entries.fix: Treat as §3 triage but trust the named resource type. Doc:

entries.cause: The subnet/image OCID in the body is cross-region, deleted, or unreadable
entries.fix: Confirm the image is published in *this* region (`oci compute image list`) and the subnet is in the same AD/VCN

entries.cause: Action issued mid-transition
entries.fix: Poll with `--wait-for-state RUNNING --max-wait-seconds 600` instead of retrying blind

entries.cause: Flex shape config outside the allowed ratio (e.g. A1 requires 6 GB per OCPU)
entries.fix: Check `oci compute shape list` for `ocpu-options` / `memory-options` bounds

entries.cause: Boot volume still attached to a terminated-but-not-deleted instance
entries.fix: Detach first, or delete the stale attachment

entries.cause: Per-resource-type cap
entries.fix: Delete unused, or raise limit

entries.cause: Compute-core quota policy in that compartment
entries.fix: `oci limits quota get --quota-id <ocid>`; amend the `set`/`zero` statement

entries.cause: Quota policies are tenancy-level
entries.fix: Must be run as an admin against the root compartment

entries.cause: Per-user API throttle; typical in multi-compartment/multi-region inventory sweeps
entries.fix: Exponential backoff + full jitter; serialize per-region; cache `list_compartments`

entries.cause: Tenancy/service throttle
entries.fix: Same, plus reduce concurrency

entries.cause: CLI has no built-in global throttle
entries.fix: Set `OCI_CLI_MAX_RETRIES` / use `--max-retries`; add sleeps between loop iterations

entries.regex: `^ERROR: Could not find config file at (?P<path>.+)$` then `Do you want to create a new config file\? \[Y/n\]:`
entries.cause: No `~/.oci/config` (or bad `--config-file`)
entries.fix: `oci setup config`. **In automation this prompt blocks forever** — set `OCI_CLI_CONFIG_FILE` or pass `--config-file` explicitly

entries.regex: `^ERROR: Profile '(?P<profile>[^']+)' not found in config file (?P<path>\S+)`
entries.cause: `--profile`/`OCI_CLI_PROFILE` names a section that isn't there
entries.fix: Add the `[PROFILE]` section, or drop to `DEFAULT`

entries.regex: `FileNotFoundError: \[Errno 2\] No such file or directory: '(?P<path>.+\.pem)'` **as a raw Python traceback**
entries.cause: `key_file` points nowhere. The CLI does **not** catch this — it dumps a full traceback from `cli_root.py:validate_label_private_key`
entries.fix: Fix `key_file` to an absolute path. Note: no `ERROR:` prefix, so log scrapers keyed on `ERROR:` miss it entirely

entries.regex: `WARNING: Permissions on (?P<path>\S+) are too open\.` + `oci setup repair-file-permissions --file <path>`
entries.cause: config/key readable by group or others
entries.fix: `oci setup repair-file-permissions --file ~/.oci/config` . Suppress with `OCI_CLI_SUPPRESS_FILE_PERMISSIONS_WARNING=True`

entries.regex: `Warning: To increase security of your API key located at .*, append an extra line with 'OCI_API_KEY' at the end\.`
entries.cause: Private key file lacks the `OCI_API_KEY` trailing line
entries.fix: Append the literal line `OCI_API_KEY` to the PEM, or set `SUPPRESS_LABEL_WARNING=True`. Cosmetic — does not block auth

entries.regex: ASCII table: `\| fingerprint \| malformed \|` with hint `openssl rsa -pubout -outform DER -in <key> \| openssl md5 -c`
entries.cause: `fingerprint` isn't 16 colon-separated hex pairs
entries.fix: Regenerate: `openssl rsa -pubout -outform DER -in key.pem \| openssl md5 -c`

entries.cause: Incomplete config stanza
entries.fix: Fill all four. The CLI lists every missing key at once — read the whole table before editing

entries.regex: `The required information to complete authentication was not provided or was incorrect\.` + `"status": 401`
entries.cause: Fingerprint is *well-formed* but the key doesn't match an uploaded API key for that user, or user/tenancy OCID is wrong
entries.fix: Reproduced live by pairing a real fingerprint with fake user/tenancy OCIDs . Confirm the fingerprint appears under the user's API Keys in Console

entries.cause: Client clock > 5 min off server
entries.fix: `timedatectl set-ntp true` / `chronyc makestep`. Doc names this explicitly:

entries.cause: `key_file` points at the **public** key (`.pub`) instead of the private key
entries.fix: Named as a distinct cause in Oracle's own 401 troubleshooting list

entries.cause: Tenancy is not subscribed to the target region
entries.fix: `oci iam region-subscription list`; subscribe in Console. Oracle's 401 troubleshooting explicitly lists "Verify your tenancy has been subscribed to the region you are targeting"

entries.regex: `"message": "The connection to endpoint timed out\."` + `"target_service": "CLI"` + `"request_endpoint": null`
entries.cause: Region string is not a real region -> unresolvable endpoint; also matches blocked egress/proxy
entries.fix: Validate against `oci iam region list`. `target_service: "CLI"` proves nothing left the host

entries.cause: Required CLI option absent
entries.fix: Local fix. No HTTP call happened; never retry

entries.regex: `Error: No such command '(?P<cmd>[^']+)'\. \(Did you mean one of: .+\)`
entries.cause: Command renamed or invented
entries.fix: Trust the suggestion list. Live example: `capacity-report` -> `compute-capacity-report`

entries.cause: `OCI_CLI_AUTH` / `OCI_CLI_RC_FILE` silently ignored in some paths
entries.fix: Known open bugs: , . Pass `--auth` / `--config-file` on the command line instead of trusting env

entries.regex: `^ERROR: No security_token_file was found in config for profile: (?P<profile>\S+)$`
entries.cause: `oci session validate` (or `--auth security_token`) on a profile that uses API-key auth
entries.fix:
Either use `--auth api_key`, or create a session: `oci session authenticate --profile-name

--region `

entries.regex: `ERROR: This CLI session has expired, so it cannot currently be used to run commands` + `Do you want to re-authenticate your CLI session profile\? \[Y/n\]:`
entries.cause: Session token TTL elapsed (~1 h default, max 24 h)
entries.fix:
`oci session refresh --profile

`, or re-run `oci session authenticate`. **The prompt hangs non-TTY automation**

entries.regex: `Unable to connect to the server: getting credentials: exec: executable oci failed with exit code 1`
entries.cause: Same as #65, but the exec credential plugin has no TTY so the real cause is invisible
entries.fix: Run any `oci` command manually to reveal the prompt, then `oci session refresh`

entries.regex: no output at all; `kubectl get ns` never returns
entries.cause: `~/.oci/config` missing/wrong, so `oci ce cluster generate-token` blocks on an interactive prompt inside the exec plugin
entries.fix: Defensive check: run `oci os ns get \| cat` before trusting kubectl

entries.cause: Session token expires during a long multipart upload
entries.fix: Use API-key or instance-principal auth for long transfers, not session tokens

entries.regex: `NotAuthorizedOrNotFound` on tenancy-level ops while compartment-level ops succeed
entries.cause: Dynamic-group policy scoped to a compartment; `list_users`/`list_policies` need a tenancy-level grant
entries.fix: Add `allow dynamic-group <dg> to inspect users in tenancy`

entries.cause: Not running on an OCI instance, or IMDSv1 disabled / metadata blocked by iptables
entries.fix: Confirm `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer Oracle" http://169.254.169.254/opc/v2/instance/`. Note IMDSv1 fallback is being removed:

entries.cause: Malformed/absent projected service-account token
entries.fix: Verify the SA token volume is mounted and the workload-identity policy exists

entries.regex: `The bucket '(?P<bucket>[^']+)' does not exist in namespace '(?P<ns>[^']+)'`
entries.cause: Wrong bucket name, wrong namespace, or wrong region
entries.fix: `oci os bucket list -c <compartment>`. Buckets are regional

entries.cause: Namespace string wrong (it is a tenancy-scoped opaque string, not the tenancy name)
entries.fix: `oci os ns get` returns the real one

entries.regex: `The compartment ID parameter must be valid\.`
entries.cause: Malformed compartment OCID passed to an Object Storage op
entries.fix: Note this is a *service-specific* code not in the common table, and it is **400 not 404**

entries.cause: `HEAD`-based ops (`oci os object head`, `oci os object get` on a missing bucket) have **no response body**, so the SDK cannot populate `code`
entries.fix: Do not branch on `code` for HEAD ops — branch on `status`. Re-issue as a `GET`/`list` to obtain a real code

entries.cause: Bucket names are unique per namespace+region
entries.fix: Pick another name or reuse the existing bucket

entries.cause: Key typo, or wrong `--namespace`
entries.fix:
`oci os object list --bucket-name --prefix

`

entries.cause: Delete attempted with objects/versions/uploads still present
entries.fix: Delete objects **and** object versions **and** abort incomplete multipart uploads first

entries.cause: Bucket's customer-managed key was disabled/deleted, or the Object Storage service principal lost `use keys`
entries.fix: Re-enable the key; add `allow service objectstorage-<region> to use keys in compartment <c>`

entries.cause: Python `email`/multipart parsing bug on upload with certain metadata
entries.fix: ; sanitize `opc-meta-*` values

entries.cause: PAR expired or was deleted
entries.fix: PARs cannot be renewed — create a new one

entries.regex: `error: You must be logged in to the server \(Unauthorized\)`
entries.cause: kubeconfig exec plugin produced no valid token: wrong CLI profile, expired session, or missing policy
entries.fix:
Regenerate: `oci ce cluster create-kubeconfig --cluster-id --region --file $HOME/.kube/config --token-version 2.0.0 --kube-endpoint PUBLIC_ENDPOINT`. If multiple profiles exist, append `--profile

` so the *generated exec command* carries it. Doc:

entries.cause: Widely-cited fix for `invalid apiVersion` errors
entries.fix: **No longer valid.** On CLI 3.91 `--help` shows `--token-version [2.0.0]` — 1.0.0 is rejected . If an agent finds this advice online, discard it

entries.regex: `Error: Unauthorized` or `Error: could not get Kubernetes client: exec plugin: invalid apiVersion "client\.authentication\.k8s\.io/v1beta1"`
entries.cause: Helm/Tiller older than 2.11 cannot use kubeconfig token v2.0.0
entries.fix: Upgrade Helm. Doc:

entries.cause: exec plugin blocked on an interactive prompt — see #67
entries.fix: Test `oci os ns get \| cat` first

entries.regex: `Unable to connect to the server: dial tcp .*: i/o timeout`
entries.cause: kubeconfig targets `PRIVATE_ENDPOINT` from outside the VCN, or Cloud Shell is in a different region
entries.fix: Use `--kube-endpoint PUBLIC_ENDPOINT`, or a bastion/VPN. Region must match for Cloud Shell private access

entries.regex: `Unable to mount volumes for pod ".*": timeout expired waiting for volumes to attach or mount`
entries.cause: Known OKE issue; CSI/attachment race
entries.fix: Doc lists it under Known Issues

entries.regex: `Error syncing load balancer: failed to ensure load balancer: Get "https://network-load-balancer-api\.\.\.": dial tcp .*: i/o timeout` or `failed to provision volume with StorageClass "oci-bv": rpc error: code = Internal desc = .* dial tcp .*: i/o timeout`
entries.cause: Worker subnet has no route to OCI service endpoints (missing service gateway / NAT / security rules)
entries.fix: Add a service gateway + route rule for "All <region> Services"; open egress 443. Doc: OKE Known Issues

entries.regex: `"code": "NotAuthorizedOrNotFound"` with `"message": "instance ocid1\.instance\.\S+ not found"` and `operation_name: get_instance`
entries.cause: Stale NPN resources referencing terminated instances
entries.fix: Oracle's documented cleanup script tolerates this; treat as benign during reconciliation

entries.cause: Known image/kubelet combination issue
entries.fix: Upgrade node image / k8s version per Known Issues

entries.cause: New compartment OCID used immediately by dependent resources; IAM is eventually consistent across regions
entries.fix: Add `depends_on` + a `time_sleep` (30-120 s), or split into two applies. Seen repeatedly: ,

entries.cause: Provider's post-create read runs against a different region/compartment, or the service principal lacks read policy
entries.fix: Check `Service:` in the block — grant that *service* the policy, not the user: ,

entries.cause: Encrypted (passphrase-protected) API key: provider path differs from CLI path
entries.fix: Use an unencrypted key or set `private_key_password`:

entries.cause: Dependent resource still attached (VNIC, backend, attachment)
entries.fix: Order with `depends_on`; the provider's own retry usually clears true transients

entries.regex: `500-InternalError` with `Out of host capacity` in Terraform
entries.cause: Same as #34
entries.fix: Vary AD/shape in the `.tf`; retrying `terraform apply` unchanged never helps

entries.cause: error text claims the latest version is 2 releases behind
entries.fix: Cosmetic provider bug: — do not chase a version upgrade based on it

entries.regex: `ORA-12506: TNS:listener rejected connection based on service ACL filtering`
entries.cause: The ADB's **network ACL / private endpoint** rejects your source IP, or the wallet's service alias is not permitted
entries.fix: Add your IP to the ADB access control list (`oci db autonomous-database get --autonomous-database-id <ocid>` -> `whitelisted-ips`); or connect from inside the VCN. Doc:

entries.regex: `ORA-12578: .*wallet file was not found or failed to open`
entries.cause: Wallet path wrong, `cwallet.sso` missing, or `TNS_ADMIN` not set to the unzipped wallet dir
entries.fix: Re-download: `oci db autonomous-database generate-wallet --autonomous-database-id <ocid> --password <pw> --file wallet.zip`; unzip; `export TNS_ADMIN=<dir>`. Doc:

entries.regex: `ORA-28000: The account is locked; login denied\.?`
entries.cause: Repeated bad logins locked `ADMIN`, or the ADB was stopped/restored
entries.fix: As an admin: `ALTER USER <u> ACCOUNT UNLOCK;`. For `ADMIN` itself use the Console/CLI admin-password reset. Doc:

entries.cause: Wrong password, or the wallet belongs to a *different* ADB
entries.fix: Reset via `oci db autonomous-database update --autonomous-database-id <ocid> --admin-password <pw>`; confirm the wallet matches the DB. Doc:

entries.cause: Wrong host/port, or the ADB is **STOPPED**
entries.fix: `oci db autonomous-database get ... --query 'data."lifecycle-state"'`; start it if `STOPPED`. Doc:

entries.regex: `ORA-12514: TNS:listener does not currently know of service requested`
entries.cause: Service name typo — ADB services are `<dbname>_high` / `_medium` / `_low` / `_tp` / `_tpurgent`
entries.fix: Read the actual aliases from the wallet's `tnsnames.ora`

entries.cause: ADB service-level concurrency cap (`_high` allows very few concurrent statements)
entries.fix: Switch to `_medium`/`_low`, or scale ECPUs

entries.cause: ADB in `PROVISIONING`/`SCALE_IN_PROGRESS`/`STOPPED`
entries.fix: Wait for `AVAILABLE`; use `--wait-for-state AVAILABLE`

entries.cause: ECPU/storage tenancy limit, or the Always-Free cap of 2 ADBs
entries.fix: `oci limits value list --service-name database --compartment-id <tenancy>`

entries.regex: `404 Not Found` on `/ords/<schema>/...` or `Request could not be processed`
entries.cause: App/workspace not deployed in *that* ADB, or the schema is not REST-enabled
entries.fix: REST-enable the schema (`ORDS.ENABLE_SCHEMA`); verify the app exists in the workspace

entries.cause: ADB stopped/restarting, or ORDS pool exhausted
entries.fix: Check ADB `lifecycle-state`; wait out the restart. On self-managed ORDS, raise `jdbc.MaxLimit`

entries.regex: `Your account has been locked` / `ORA-28000` on the APEX internal workspace
entries.cause: Failed `ADMIN` logins
entries.fix: Reset the APEX instance admin password via `APEX_INSTANCE_ADMIN`; or reset the ADB `ADMIN` password

entries.regex: `401 Unauthorized` on an ORDS REST endpoint
entries.cause: Missing OAuth client / privilege mapping
entries.fix: Create the OAuth client and map the privilege to the module pattern

entries.cause: Mismatch between the ADB's public/private ACL and the browser's source IP
entries.fix: Same ACL fix as #97

entries.cause: Standard service error as a Python exception
entries.fix: Catch `oci.exceptions.ServiceError`; branch on `e.code` and `e.status`; log `e.request_id`

entries.cause: `~/.oci/config` absent
entries.fix: Same as #49, but raised as a typed exception rather than a prompt

entries.cause: Missing/invalid keys in the config dict
entries.fix: `oci.config.validate_config(config)` before constructing clients

entries.cause: The waiter's own `get` hit NAONF because the resource was deleted mid-wait
entries.fix: Pass `succeed_on_not_found=True` to `oci.wait_until` for delete waits

entries.cause: Waiter timed out; the operation may still be running
entries.fix: Raise `max_wait_seconds`; re-`get` before assuming failure

entries.cause: Network/DNS/proxy, or bogus region
entries.fix: Mirror of the CLI's `RequestException` (§6 #60)

entries.cause: SDK composite-operation bug
Same service error
entries.fix: `e.getStatusCode()`, `e.getServiceCode()`, `e.getOpcRequestId()`

entries.cause: Same
entries.fix: `common.IsNetworkError(err)` to separate transport from service faults

entries.cause: Client too old for a new field/enum
entries.fix: Upgrade the SDK before believing a "server bug"

entries.cause: Bad region, blocked egress, corporate proxy
entries.fix: Set `HTTPS_PROXY`; verify with `curl -sI https://identity.<region>.oci.oraclecloud.com`

entries.cause: Corporate MITM proxy
entries.fix: Point `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` at the corporate CA bundle. Never disable verification

entries.cause: 10 VCNs/region default
entries.fix: Raise limit or reuse

entries.cause: Overlapping CIDR with a peered VCN
entries.fix: Re-plan addressing; peering rejects overlaps permanently

entries.cause: VNICs/LB/mount targets still attached
entries.fix: Delete dependents first; the message often names the blocking type
